subject: SummitWorks go-forward pact: milestones & owners
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@summitworks.com>, Kendra Park <kendra.park@summitworks.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SummitWorks go-forward pact: milestones & owners

Team — attaching a proposed go-forward "pact" (mutual action plan) so we have a single source of truth for responsibilities, milestone dates, and acceptance criteria as we prepare for production. Key points up front:

- Goal: Pilot live with 1 tenant, basic chat + embeddings, by 2027-01-20; full rollout by 2027-02-28 (proposed).
- High-level owners: SummitWorks = data & integration; Redwood = model serving, infra, and admin ops.
- Critical path items: SSO, data migration, security review, procurement/SOW sign-off.

Please review the attachment (SummitWorks-MAP-v1.xlsx) — sheet 1 is milestones, sheet 2 is owners/RACI, sheet 3 lists open dependencies. Specific asks for this week:
1) Confirm primary PM and engineering owners from SummitWorks (we've put Alex and Kendra as provisional).
2) Flag any regulatory or network constraints that would block the proposed pilot window.
3) If dates look tight, suggest target shift (we're flexible + want a realistic plan).

I propose a short 30-minute alignment call tomorrow at 10:00 PT if that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0189

Attachments: SummitWorks-MAP-v1.xlsx (milestones & RACI)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@summitworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kendra Park <kendra.park@summitworks.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SummitWorks go-forward pact: milestones & owners

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan and for sending the spreadsheet. A few quick clarifying items from our side:

- The proposed pilot date (2027-01-20) is aggressive given our internal holidays and a concurrent data migration from legacy search we’ve got slated in late Jan. Can we discuss shifting pilot + full rollout by 1–2 weeks?
- Who will own transformation scripts for historical data? SummitWorks engineering can do mapping, but we’ll need Redwood to validate tokenization and embedding schema.
- SSO: we use Okta; need to confirm Redwood supports SCIM provisioning and whether the admin UX will let our security team disable external sharing.
- Procurement: procurement will need the SOW and a list of what data types are stored and access controls before Dec 15 to get budget approval in time.

Can we get a short note from your engineering/CS lead on migration responsibilities and a first pass at the SSO plan? Also, a demo of the admin console for our security team would help.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Product Operations | SummitWorks
alex.moreno@summitworks.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@summitworks.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SummitWorks go-forward pact: milestones & owners — migration & SSO notes

Alex — quick answers from CS/engineering: happy to own the migration validation and provide runbooks; details below:

- Data migration: SummitWorks to perform initial ETL and mapping. Redwood will validate by running a tokenization/embedding audit and provide a short script set (Python) to check schema compatibility. Owner: SummitWorks Eng (Kendra) + Redwood CS (Marcus). Target deliverable: migration validation checklist (due 2026-12-20).
- SSO/SCIM: Redwood supports Okta SAML and SCIM provisioning. We will provide a SCIM connector guide and a test workspace for integration. Security control: admin console includes sharing toggles; we can disable external share at tenant level. Owner: Redwood Eng (Monica).
- Timeline: given SummitWorks' migration calendar, propose shifting pilot to 2027-01-27 and full rollout to 2027-03-07. That gives 1 week buffer on the pilot and 1 week on rollout. See updated milestones in attached MAP.

Next steps:
- Jordan: coordinate a 30-minute technical kickoff with SummitWorks Eng & Redwood CS next week (Jan 4–6 window suggested).
- Kendra: confirm your engineering lead and preferred data migration window.

I attached an updated MAP (SummitWorks-MAP-v1-updated.xlsx) with the revised dates and a short RACI snippet.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com

Attachments: SummitWorks-MAP-v1-updated.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@summitworks.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SummitWorks go-forward pact: milestones & owners — SOW & procurement

Alex — looping in a brief commercial note to help procurement: attached is a draft SOW and an outline of what will be included in the pilot billing (SOW-Draft.pdf). Key dates to note for procurement approval: please aim to route the SOW internally by Dec 10 for signing before Dec 20 so we can reserve capacity for your pilot window.

Highlights in the SOW draft:
- Pilot scope and acceptance criteria (mapped to MAP milestones)
- Billing cadence and estimated usage profile for pilot + month-1 production
- Security addendum checklist (SOC 2, data retention, KMS integration windows)

Jordan will follow up with a shared DocuSign link once you confirm the SOW language and FOA.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: SOW-Draft.pdf

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@summitworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kendra Park <kendra.park@summitworks.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SummitWorks go-forward pact: milestones & owners — CONFIRMED

Thanks team — this looks good and I appreciate the proactive notes. Confirming the following from SummitWorks:

- Kendra Park is our PM and will be the primary day-to-day contact for the pilot (kendra.park@summitworks.com).
- We accept the shifted dates: pilot 2027-01-27, rollout 2027-03-07.
- Procurement will review the SOW this week; we'll aim to return comments by Dec 10.
- For migration, SummitWorks Eng will own the ETL, and Redwood will validate tokenization as Marcus outlined.

Jordan — please go ahead and book the Jan 4 technical kickoff (30m). We're targeting a short admin console demo for our security team during that call.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
